hits.summary: Randstad is seeking a highly detailed and organized Project Control Specialist for a prominent client in the Washington, D.C. area. In this role, you will drive project delivery excellence across nationwide technology deployments by managing project controls, tracking financial metrics, and facilitating seamless cross-functional communication. Acting as a core liaison between leadership, project teams, and external vendors, you will oversee project schedules, risk registers, and operational governance to ensure complex ADA assistive technology installations remain on time, within budget, and fully aligned with organizational standards.
qualifications:
Deployment Experience: Proven track record supporting large-scale, multi-site, or nationwide technology deployment projects.

Project Controls Expertise: Strong skills in project coordination, financial/variance reporting, risk tracking, and stakeholder management.

Vendor Management: Background in managing external vendor relationships and facilitating inter-team communications.

Technical & Analytical Proficiency: Advanced skills in Microsoft 365 (Excel, PowerPoint) and standard project management tracking software.

Communication Skills: Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities with experience presenting complex data and forecasts to leadership.
responsibilities:
Project Tracking & Execution: Maintain project schedules, trackers, action logs, risk registers, and status reporting artifacts to oversee the nationwide deployment and installation of ADA assistive technology solutions.

Financial & Performance Analysis: Support program management activities, including financial tracking, accrual management, budget monitoring, resource utilization, and project forecasting.

Executive Reporting: Prepare weekly project status reports, executive summaries, variance reporting, and data analytics to evaluate project performance and recommend delivery improvements.

Stakeholder & Vendor Liaison: Facilitate communication between internal stakeholders, external vendors, and project teams; draft and distribute meeting summaries, action items, and project updates.

Risk & Governance Management: Monitor project milestones, identify dependencies, and proactively escalate risks and issues to ensure strict program governance.

Continuous Improvement: Support ongoing process improvement initiatives and assist in developing project management best practices, documentation, and presentation materials.

Industry leading manufacturer is looking for a Maintenance Manager in the Calmet City, Illinois area.

hits.summary:
We are seeking a safety-focused and dependable Flight Service Operator (FSO) - Tier 1 to support innovative commercial drone delivery operations across in Montgomery, TX.
A current FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate is required for this position.

This is a hands-on, field-based position supporting the safe and efficient operation of unmanned aircraft systems (UAS). The Flight Service Operator will perform aircraft and ground equipment inspections, assist with daily flight operation activities, participate in crew briefings, and maintain communication with the Pilot-in-Command.
qualifications:
Current FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate required.

Valid driver's license and current automobile insurance.

Ability to successfully complete required background and motor vehicle record checks.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety.

Ability to follow detailed procedures and operational protocols.

Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively as part of a flight operations team.

Ability to maintain consistent mental and visual alertness throughout the shift.

Flexibility to work within operational hours between 8:00 AM and 9:30 PM CT, Monday through Sunday, based on assigned schedule and business needs.
Lift and carry up to 35 pounds from ground level.

Carry multiple items simultaneously when required.

Crouch and pick up or place objects weighing up to 20 pounds at ground level.

Push or pull a wheeled cart weighing up to 200 pounds on level ground.

Remain on their feet and walk extensively throughout the workday, potentially 10,000+ steps per day.

Perform work outdoors for extended periods.

Work safely in varying weather conditions, including light rain, wind, heat, and cold, with temperatures potentially ranging from approximately 23°F to 110°F.
#LI-KC1
responsibilities:
As a Flight Service Operator, you will:

  • Perform pre-flight and post-flight aircraft inspections.
  • Complete required start-of-day and end-of-day operational activities.
  • Perform routine aircraft procedures in accordance with established UAS maintenance and operating standards.
  • Inspect drone nest and associated ground equipment before and after flight operations.
  • Replace designated nest equipment as required.
  • Assist with the setup and breakdown of equipment used to support daily drone delivery operations.
  • Participate in daily crew briefings and operational discussions.
  • Maintain clear and professional communication with the Pilot-in-Command and other members of the flight operations team.
  • Follow established FAA regulations, safety procedures, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and company protocols.
  • Identify and communicate aircraft, equipment, safety, or operational concerns.
  • Travel between multiple operational locations throughout the workday as business needs require.

hits.summary:
We are seeking a motivated, hands-on Order Fulfillment Specialist / Ground Handler Tier 1 to join a fast-paced fulfillment and drone delivery operation in Newnan, GA.

This is an active, operational role where you will be directly involved in the day-to-day movement of customer orders-from picking and packing through quality control and loading packages onto delivery aircraft.

This position is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in retail, warehouse, logistics, fulfillment, or other fast-paced operations who enjoys working on their feet and is interested in developing their leadership skills. In addition to performing core operational duties, you will have opportunities to support the Operations Team Lead and take on additional responsibilities as needed.

Why Join This Team?

This opportunity provides hands-on experience within an innovative fulfillment and delivery operation while allowing you to build experience in logistics, inventory, quality control, safety, and team leadership.

For candidates interested in growing their operations career, this role provides exposure to both frontline fulfillment activities and the responsibilities involved in supporting an Operations Team Lead.
qualifications:
What We're Looking For
Experience
1-2 years of experience in a fast-paced environment such as retail, warehouse, logistics, fulfillment, distribution, or similar operations
Experience with picking, packing, inventory, order fulfillment, shipping/receiving, or other operational processes is helpful but not required for candidates with transferable experience
Leadership Potential
Strong desire to grow into additional leadership responsibilities
Previous experience training, coaching, mentoring, or supporting coworkers is a plus
Comfortable taking initiative and leading by example
Supply Chain & Operational Knowledge
General understanding of warehouse, fulfillment, retail, or supply chain processes
Exposure to performance metrics such as order accuracy, cycle times, productivity, or throughput is preferred
Strong attention to accuracy and detail
Communication & Safety
Strong interpersonal and communication skills
Ability to work effectively as part of a team in a fast-moving environment
Safety-focused mindset and willingness to follow detailed procedures and SOPs
Physical & Work Environment Requirements

Candidates must be able to:

Work outdoors and in varying weather conditions
Stand and remain active for extended periods
Comfortably lift and handle items weighing up to 35 lbs
Perform repetitive picking, packing, loading, and inventory-related activities
Work effectively in a fast-paced operational environment
Schedule Requirements

This position requires schedule flexibility.

Candidates must be available to work within the operating window of: 8:30 AM - 9:15 PM, 7 days per week.
Employees will work 40 hours per week based on the assigned schedule and operational needs. Weekend availability is required. Adherence to assigned work hours is essential for this operation.
skills: Flexibility,Communication,leads by example,leadership,packing,Leadership Potential,logistics,coaching,throughput,picking,performance metrics,Strong interpersonal and communication skills,retail,Selling,warehouse,supply chain processes,Supply Chain Knowledge
responsibilities:
As a Ground Handler Tier 1, you will:

  • Pick & Pack Orders: Accurately locate, pick, and pack customer orders according to established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Perform Quality Control: Complete weight, accuracy, and quality checks to ensure orders meet operational requirements before delivery.
  • Load Delivery Aircraft: Safely and securely load approved packages onto delivery aircraft while following all required safety procedures.
  • Prepare the Site for Operations: Assist with morning setup and ensure the operational area is clean, organized, safe, and ready for daily activity.
  • Support Inventory Management: Perform daily inventory counts and help maintain accurate stock levels.
  • Maintain Equipment: Handle operational equipment carefully and report equipment, safety, or maintenance concerns.
  • Support Team Leadership: Assist the Operations Team Lead with daily activities and help maintain an efficient workflow during busy periods.
  • Maintain Safety Standards: Follow all safety policies, SOPs, and operational procedures while maintaining strong attention to detail.
